item.coloph: 'gro mgon drung mu'i bon skor yin/ da lta zhu btsun blo gros bzang / lhad med thugs dam drin dngos nas/ zhus bris dge ba'i 'gror khyab shog gnyan sa'i tshogs 'khor 'khyer bde'i sper (phyir)/ dge sbyong mtshams pa bris pa dge bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling yongs khyab shog bkra shis par shog zhal dro/ byin che bar shog smon lam//
